name: Design of Sustainable Habitats
description: By the end of the course, students will understand the principles and frameworks of sustainable habitat design. Use tools such as life cycle assessment, carbon and water footprinting, thermal comfort analysis, and spatial mapping. Learn from traditional, vernacular, and emerging ecological practices in India. Prototype low-carbon, inclusive, climate-responsive design interventions. Engage in participatory and systems-based design processes.
